risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified and transparent on loan growth, charge-offs, revenues, expenses, debt, borrowing availability, and covenant compliance. Credit risk remains material, with net charge-offs at 14.3% of average loans and substantial covenant, refinancing, and borrowing-base exposure, although improving earnings and declining loss ratios support a moderately positive tone. Forward-looking statements about tax competition, expansion, and covenant impact are less specific and partly offset the otherwise detailed disclosure.
